chapters: Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bɨɨx dɨr vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios gu vaakax guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' tu' gu maa'nkar ua'tulhi'ñ maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu chio'ñ cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' aagak guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu novɨ bhaan mo'o maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' ai'chdhix uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tuur guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios xikoolh bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tai bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu u'u bhaan gu tai.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ mo'o guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhaan gu u'u bhaan gu tai guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu jiim jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx gu suudai' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨx bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan tu jiim jix duu gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu maa'nkar na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan ua'tulhi'ñ kakneer ali' karneer chiiw gu chio'ñ cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xikoolh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx mo'o guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan gu u'u bhaan gu tai guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu jiim jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ba'k guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx gu suudai'; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan tu jiim jix duu gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' maa'nkar tai bhaan bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios gu u'uvhig guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan tu' jix duu mo'o guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ju'ñdharan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan tas buusñi pai' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu' cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gook; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan gu u'u guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu tai; mi' dhɨr maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan tu jiim jix duu gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan kubhion.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix bhuup guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨ'ñdhatu' bɨɨx bɨx kubhion guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan na ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu jiim jix duu gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam maa'nkar na jix maa guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duu gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham jabka' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' jajar cham jabka' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Gu' gu' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ua'tulhi'ñ gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham jabka' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan bɨ'ñdhatu'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ua'tulhi'ñ gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam dhi' tu'x guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chɨ'ñchoka' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan jix duu tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam maa'nkar na jix maa guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx jabka'; na gu' matgɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' matgɨm suudai' na jix bhai' tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios; gu' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu tai kaipgaidhat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim kai'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' ka't jugi pai' jix bhaan; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam abhaar.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' jix gaki ka't bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam maa'n na ja'p.
Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ taxchaabgidhat taxchaabgi'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar taxchaabgidhat taxchaabgi'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ cham jabka' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' jajar cham jabka' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu takarui' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam taxchaabgi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm baasɨ'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam taxchaabgidhat taxchaabgi'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tanoolh ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn cham tu' na ba' gu tanoolh.

Gu' gu' tu' gu maa'nkar ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu maa'nkar ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jugi tu' gu tanoolh buimgidhak.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ba' vaik gu tanoolh gu chuukug gu maa'nkar ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu tai.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu chuukug gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vaik gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ cham ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug kuichdha' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' gu tai ka't vaak na jix bhaan; gu' no'x na jix bhai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga kuichdha' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñaanbi' no'x guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu chuukug gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu noobh guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ maa'nkar na jix maa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨɨx baaso; mi' dhɨr baaso na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ja'p gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gu' baaso ka't gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix jum daa'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix dhaas guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan mo'o; gio ba' bhaan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix dhaas guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios abhaar; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duu gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Moisees bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x mi'p jix bhaan duu.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan kɨɨv mui'kim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam suudai' buusñi guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na ba' jix bhaan duu.
Jano' ba' ja'aa bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan mo'o gu Aaroon guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' jix bhaan duu.

Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr gu Moisees guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn kutun na jix toja guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu jiim na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tuur guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix dhaas gu noobh bhaan mo'o tuur guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' gu Moisees jix bhɨɨ gu ɨ'ɨr jix dhaas bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhaan a'aa' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xikoolh guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ɨ'ɨr tɨɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix bhaan duu na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan.

Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ bɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ka't bhaan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu' gu Moisees guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Gu' gu' tuur guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu chuukug guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu tai mai' vaak ja'tkam; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duu gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix dhaas gu noobh bhaan mo'o gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Moisees gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' gu Moisees jix duu guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ mo'o guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx gu suudai' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Moisees bɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr na ja'p ka't gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix dhaas gu noobh bhaan mo'o gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Moisees gu ɨ'ɨr jix dhaas bhaan guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam naak jix duu gu Aaroon bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu novɨ bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tɨɨt.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix dhaas gu Moisees gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhaan gu noobh guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhaan tɨɨt guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Moisees gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ka't bhaan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix duu.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ka't vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ cham jabka' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu takarui' bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix dhaas bɨɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix duu.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix dhaas bɨx gu noobh gu Aaroon gu noobh gu ma'nkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ mii' dhɨr tu'x gu Moisees gu noobh tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Moisees baaso guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ka't baasɨ'n gu Moisees; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duu gu Moisees.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Moisees bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan gu Aaroon bhaan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan gu ma'nkam bhaan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam bɨɨx; gio ba' jix bhaan duu gu Aaroon guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam bɨɨx.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu chuukug ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx gu takarui' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhaan tu' jix duu bham; jano' ba' gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jugi.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu chuukug gu takarui' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix duu gu tai.

Jano' ba' ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios kɨɨv gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu tanoolh guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv gu tanoolh boopoya' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut dhi' gu tanoolh gu tukaa' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jir bɨx bhai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' cham vaak jodai; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Moisees jup tɨɨt gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam daraa gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' bhɨɨk jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees; gio ba' dhi' jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu vupui guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vupui guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu vupui gio gu maa'nkar gu ja'tkam gu vupui guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; jano' ba' na ja'p tu' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Aaroon jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tuur guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Gu' gu' gu chuukug guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu tai mai' vaak ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mi' dhɨr maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mo'o; gio ba' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' makgɨrxi gio gu maa'nkar gu ja'tkam jix bhɨɨ gu chio'ñ chiiw ka't na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios makgɨrxi guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm uañi'ñ na ja'p maa'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu makgɨrxi maa'nkar tai bhaan tu' bhaan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' jix duu makgɨrxi guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn maa'nkar tai bhaan gu xibh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gio gu vaakax gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ka't gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xikoolh.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaakax; gio ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ba'k guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Aaroon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duu gu Moisees.

Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Aaroon gu noobh bhaan gu ja'tkam jix bhai' aa'; gio ba' jix dhaav guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' baap gu Moisees gu Aaroon vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' moor jix bhai' aa' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix buus gu tai vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ia'rɨ bhaan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu Nadab gu Abiuu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam maa'n vaak na jix bhaan jix dhaas gu tai bhaan jix dhaas guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tai guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios cham pai' dhuuk jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu tai vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix koko' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' dhi' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tas na jix gɨ'; jano' ba' gu Aaroon guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt gu Moisees gu Misael gu Elsapaan gu ma'nkam gu Ussiel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Aaroon; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix buusñi gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan xidhuu mai' yooxi'.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx kutun na jix toja mai' yooxi' na ja'p gu Moisees.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu Eleasar gu Itamar gu ma'nkam; na gu' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ɨɨbhidham tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jajannulhi'ñ na gu' cham vaak jodai tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ja'tkam bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na gu' koi; na gu' bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr jix duu jurtu'nka' tu ñi'ook gu Moisees.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Aaroon bham.

Na pai' dhuuk tu' gu ma'nkam bɨndak cham i'i suudai' u'va tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat baakɨi vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na gu' cham vaak jodai; gio ba' ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' na ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhaan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñaanbi' na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx ñi'ook kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Moisees.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu Eleasar gu Itamar gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ maa'nkar na jix maa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham jabka' ju'ñdharan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam abhaar.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jugi pai' jix bhaan; na gu' dhi' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' gu ma'nkam maa'nkar na jix maa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix duu.

Na gu' jugi guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam pai' na jix bhai' tu' gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bɨndak baaso guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat makgɨrxi'ñdha' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx maa'nkar na jix maa guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ baaso ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ma'nkam bɨndak na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu.

Jano' ba' gu Moisees guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu chio'ñ chiiw guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ñi'ook ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' bhaam bhaan gu Eleasar tu' gu Itamar gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bham.

Na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam pai' jix bhaan na gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam abhaar jix maa guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' na cham jir bhai' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ba' ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ɨ'ɨr cham ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu jiim xidhuu; gio ba' dua'ñ jugi pai' jix bhaan na ja'p tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Aaroon gu Moisees; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' tu'x; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Moisees jix kai dhi' jix maa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu vaakax jugi bɨx gu vaakax bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn juraa'n guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jugi.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn cham jugi guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn namki' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; na gu' jix ai na gu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu' cham juraa'n guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix xoi'kam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñaanbi'.
Na gu' gio guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na gu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu' cham juraa'n guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gui'x guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñaanbi'.
Na gu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na gu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu' cham juraa'n guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gui'x guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Na gu' gio guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na gu' juraa'n guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu' cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gui'x guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug cham jugi tu' kuichdha' gu chuukug jix koi; gio ba' gui'x guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' dhi' jugi guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x gu suudai'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x namki' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu suudai' gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mii' dhɨr jugi.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x cham namki' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨx gu ko'oi gu suudai' na ja'p bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na jix do'ig gu suudai' gui'x guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu chuukug cham jugi guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu chuukug koko'kam.
Jano' ba' bɨx cham palhɨɨp guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu suudai' gui'x guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu u'uvhig guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gui'x guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' cham jugi ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' gu u'uuv guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan na jax chu'm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ko'oi guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan maakobh tɨɨt gui'x guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn dhi' jugi bɨx gu ko'oi guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan maakobh tɨɨt palhɨɨp guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tɨɨt na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx bhaan gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jugi; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan na jax chu'm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhaan na jax chu'm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhaan na jax chu'm guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ko'oi guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ maakobh tɨɨt gui'x guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' tu'x boopoya' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' no'x kuichdha' gu chuukug koko'kam ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' no'x guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu chuukug koko'kam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jajannulhi'ñ ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu' cham juraa'n guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gui'x guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñaanbi'; gio ba' no'x kuichdha' ka't ñaanbi'.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaakax guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios maakobh tɨɨt gui'x guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñaanbi' no'x guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bhaan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' no'x kuichdha' gu chuukug koko'kam ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu chuukug koko'kam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jajannulhi'ñ ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix xoi'kam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gui'x guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ko'oi guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan gu oidha'; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gui'x guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨx gu ko'oi; na pai' dhuuk no'x kuichdha' na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ koko'kam ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.

Jano' ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr bhaan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios oi'ñdha' mi' dhɨr koko'kam ka't ñaanbi'; gio ba' vaaso gu u'u na ja'p tɨi'chu' zel guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu duukam ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu suudai' ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai ka't na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook bhi'ñ tu jiim guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios oi'ñdha' bɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ka't ñaanbi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhaan daraibu' gu suudai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr bhaan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu chuukug jix koi ka't ñaanbi'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gui'x.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx suudai' buusñi guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn pai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu suudai' ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gu' bhɨɨya' dhaa gu chuukug koko'kam ka't ñaanbi'.

Na gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu jiim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na gu' cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ xidhuu na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees dhi' gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu' gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ bɨx gu kai' gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu'x guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios ua'tulhdhidha' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan vupui bhaan tu' ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu chio'ñ gu kai' gu Aaroon ua'tulhi'ñ gakiidha' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ɨ'ra'n cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu'x guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm na jix bhai'; gio ba' kuichdha' no'x guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu chio'ñ bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ bhɨɨya' dhaa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ko'oi guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't ñaanbi' tu' gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ñaanbi' jurtu'nka' no'x guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga kuichdha' ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu'x guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam va'k ka't tooton gu chuukug bɨɨx gu suudai'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tas guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn ka't na jix bhai'; na gu' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu'x guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na gu' gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jir bɨx bhai' cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ uañi'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn cham ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' onbai' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk gu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tuumiñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm maaxir gu vaak; gio ba' suulhgia' jugi gu takarui'.

Na pai' dhuuk cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mar u'vɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar tu'x guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Gu' gu' tu' mar u'vɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ua'tulhi'ñ ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham palhɨɨp guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak gu taat na ja'p guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu takarui' gu taat; gu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jixchamaam maa'n jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu'x guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' cham jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' na cham jir bhai' uañi'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu'x guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu chio'ñ gu vaak gu Israeel jix duu gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' aagak guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu chio'ñ cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ ali' karneer tɨjɨɨ'ñ chiiw.
Na gu' matgɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na gu' cham ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kakneer cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' cham tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' bai'ñchu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ suulhgia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu vaakax gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios cham ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu oidha' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu novɨ gu mar ja'tkam mii' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' tu'x; na gu' ja'bsuna'; mi' dhɨr cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Na pai' dhuuk gu vaakax mar kaneer chiiw na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios kɨɨv gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu naan; gu' dɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tanoolh guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga na ba' gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't gu vaakax gu ñi'ook cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu tanoolh gu mar.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu maa'nkar taxchaabgidhat taxchaabgi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios aagak maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na ba' gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Na guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' gu Ejipto na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam kɨɨv gu tanoolh juanda' jɨɨpi'ñka' ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa abhaar; gio ba' matgɨm tu duukam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; mi' dhɨr juanda' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ maa'n guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gakdhi'ñchix gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tanoolh dhi' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jugi guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu tanoolh gui'x abhaar guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; gio ba' matgɨm tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan; gio ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh ka't abhaar guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; mi' dhɨr matgɨm tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ dharka' gu i'bhɨ oraa'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' buimgidhak gu tanoolh juanda' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mar kaneer oidha' tas cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't gook guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ baasɨ'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' cham jugi gu takarui' tu' kai'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx ka'm dhi' gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam dɨr buimgidhak gu tanoolh juanda' dɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' kɨɨv guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ka't.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm buimgidhak gu tanoolh juanda' kɨɨv guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam mambhɨɨx gu tanoolh; gio ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix vɨɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gook gu takarui' na ba' gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ka't gook guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨɨx jabka' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx gu takarui' kɨɨv ali' karneer oidha' tas cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tuur guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gook gu chuukug; gio ba' ka't maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; mi' dhɨr gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan jix duu tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu chio'ñ chiiw guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' gook ali' karneer oidha' tas gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu takarui' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gook ali' karneer; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' gu tanoolh; gio ba' ka't abhaar guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; mi' dhɨr matgɨm tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; jano' ba' ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu oidha' cham gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oraa'; na ba' gampai' na ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr kiicha'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kɨɨv maa'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gui'x juanda' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk abhaar guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Jano' ba' matgɨm tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mambhɨɨx dhi' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kɨɨv ka't gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' gui'x abhaar guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' matgɨm tu duukam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ dhi' gu tanoolh; na gu' gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' tu jiim vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' bɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' gu tanoolh ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' no'x guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu duukam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' gu tanoolh tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' matgɨm tu duukam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu Saabado jɨɨpi'ñka' ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu i'ii'ñ kua'da' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu xumai; gio ba' gu xumai guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ juanda'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tanoolh dhi' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kɨɨv ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios abhaar guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; gio ba' matgɨm tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tanoolh gui'x abhaar guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; jano' ba' matgɨm tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn juana' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ maa'nkar na jix maa guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kɨɨv na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' maa'n gu tanoolh ka't juanda'; mi' dhɨr juanda' ka't gio guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam maa'n gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx gu i'bhɨ gu u'u tu jiim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam mamraga'n gu u'u guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv gu tanoolh oidha' tas; gio ba' ka't ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kɨɨv guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Israeel guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Na pai' dhuuk na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' gu Ejipto; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bhaan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tɨtɨɨya bɨɨx tas.

Jano' ba' mai' tu jiim chuut vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Aaroon dɨr gu xumai bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx tas; gio ba' ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' bhaan mɨichdhai na jix bhai' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx tas guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tɨtɨɨya vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ka't gook guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' tu jiim gook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan meesa na jix bhai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gio bhaan guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam kubhion na jix bhai' ka't na ba' gu takarui' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh juanda' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx tas guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jugi pai' jix bhaan; na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam abhaar na ba' maa'nkar na jix maa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu mar gu u'vɨ gu Israelita ka't gu mar gu Egipkio jix buus tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu mar gu Israelita gu chio'ñ gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vaak ja'tkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu mar gu u'vɨ gu Israelita guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu tɨɨgɨ' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' jano' ba' bhɨɨk gu Moisees; mi' dhɨr gu naan guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Selomit mar u'vɨ gu Dribi bopxi'ñ gu Dan.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas kuupa' bɨɨx ka'm jum duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' jix buusñi guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mai' vaak ja'tkam bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu noobh bhaan mo'o guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' no'x guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' na cham jir bhai'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix koi; gio ba' bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr ja'tkam mii' dhɨr na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ koi'm no'x guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn koi'm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' jix duu; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx bɨx dhi' kua' gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ñi'ook na tu a'ga dhi' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu kavɨk gu Sinaii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Moisees.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhaan.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu oidha' dɨr oidha' tas guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Jano' ba' tu' jix bhaan duu gu oidha' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat u'ua'tɨda' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jixchamaam tuumiñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba'.

Jano' ba' bɨx jix duu ka't jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn xidhuu; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn juraa'n guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Gu' gu' matgɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios oi'ñdha' bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios bɨx palhɨɨp gu chichio'ñ gu vaakax guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu maa'nkar cham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jixchamaam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kakneer bɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' cham tu jiim tu' jix bhai' cham bhai' tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't tu'x guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu kavɨk gu Sinaii.
